classification: All findings are public 40-hex vulnerability fix commit URLs, not credentials.
validation: Re-read each exact line from its original commit and require complete trusted-host URL-field grammar.

secondary_report_false_positives.classification: The original redacted report repeats its actual historical source commit ID, which the same Sourcegraph rule re-detects.
secondary_report_false_positives.exception: Only the exact historical commit field in gitleaks-history.json is permitted. All credential-shaped fields remain scanned.
